review: Independent cross-unit semantic findings for OOD N04 package20

findings.reason: Both ask the meter operator/API to report an overlap with the committed window and not reserve; hiding the interval index changes encapsulation, not the keyed collision decision.
Both ask for the result of forfeiting an already-final match after the bracket advanced; the added stale-screen fact does not change the rejected outcome carrying the recorded final result.
The same return-inspection boundary is keyed: record/return condition evidence while leaving the later refund decision outside.

Both ask what happens when a stable request identity is retried after a successful financial operation; return the original result and do not post again. The refund bound does not change the retry action.
The inspection-screen capability again returns classification only and excludes the later refund decision, duplicating the accepted N01 response and N02 condition-report decision.
Both use the same experiment publication facts and key to persist the exact dataset/code revision pair for later audit; the marker-interface framing does not change that decision.

nonfindingExample.reason: The N04 item selects the provider-adapter invocation using a stable provider key and receipt; the accepted N01 item selects the ledger-facing already-applied outcome. Those are different boundary operations, not merely the same label.

limitations: Unit-level semantic reports remain scoped to their frozen current objects; this cross review does not convert them into source or runtime acceptance.
No global unique-concept, option-length, or prose quota is imposed.
Accepted N01/N02 controls were read-only and remain unchanged.
